metadata.description: A skill factory for data engineers: reverse engineering, modernization, SQL, dbt, modeling, pipelines, Fabric, Snowflake, Power BI, quality and ops, architecture docs, a job line that pushes work through gated stages, and the tooling to create and eval new skills. The Data Warrior is the doctrine.
